title: User Blocking: Complete Guide
summary: This document explains how “blocking” works: blocked users cannot send payment requests, and they are notified they have been blocked. It sets a maximum block list size of $275 users and requires a 12-hour wait after unblocking before re-blocking the same user.
faqs: What happens when I block someone (payment requests and notifications)?
How many users can I block—what is the $275 limit?
How do I block a user from their profile?
How do I unblock a user from my block list?
If I unblock someone, how long do I have to wait before blocking them again (12 hours)?
If I can’t block a user, what troubleshooting steps should I follow?
keywords: Blocked users can’t send payment requests
Troubleshooting: reached $275 / wait 12 hours / verify correct profile
